status: Provisional tuning from an abstract encounter simulation; requires live playtesting.

rules.evolution_rule: Both ingredients at rank 3. At 4, 6 and 8 minutes, grant one eligible evolution, without spending a level-up. Choose if several qualify; maximum two evolutions per run. Ingredient effects remain; the evolution changes only its stated subsystem. No evolution is awarded if no recipe is ready.
rules.offer_rule: First pick offers Personal Space, Additional Laser and Extra Hands. Later picks offer three distinct eligible cards, including one owned card whenever possible. Three full-offer rerolls per run. Exclude maxed cards, unmet prerequisites and new lines after eight lines are installed. Remaining random slots roll rarity 60/35/5, then choose a line; renormalize empty tiers. Once eight lines are installed, remaining picks rank them up.
rules.stacking: Bonuses within a named stat add; different stats multiply. Cap total firing rate at 2x base including temporary bonuses; cap movement at 1.6x base. Proc damage cannot trigger other procs. Bonus rewards do not grant extra upgrade picks in this model.
rules.shield_rule: Shield capacity = 25 per Personal Space rank + 15 per Bigger Bubble rank. Recharges at 5/s after 5 seconds without damage. Recharge delay has a 2-second floor. Hull damage, not shield damage, resets Performance Bonus.
rules.shield_siphon_cap: At most 4 shield/second across all captures. Employee Benefits uses the same shared cap.
rules.repair_rule: Repair Nanites heals 2/3/4 hull per 10 biological captures at ranks 1/2/3. Vehicles never trigger capture procs.
rules.target_rule: Tractor beams target biological specimens by default. Lasers skip vehicles already being lifted. Vehicles become eligible only through Heavy Lifting, count as two occupied beams, and yield 5 ordinary-capture reward units. Bosses are immune to capture, hard disable, pulling and instant removal. Slow effects on bosses are capped at 20%.
rules.temporary_bonus_rule: Temporary effects refresh duration; they do not stack with themselves. Bulk Collection lasts 2 seconds, Biofuel 3 seconds, Hostile Takeover 5 seconds. EMP has a shared 4-second cooldown. Emergency Jump has no offensive effect.

upgrades.name: Extra Hands
upgrades.effect: Additional simultaneous targets; maximum four base beams.

upgrades.name: Heavy Lifting
ranks: Capture jeeps at or below 40% HP
Jeeps at or below 55% HP; vehicle capture +20% faster
Jeeps at or below 70% HP; tanks at or below 35% HP; vehicle capture +40% faster
upgrades.effect: Vehicles need two beam slots and base 3 seconds to capture; one vehicle per 8 seconds. Tanks retain a minimum 2-second capture time.

upgrades.name: Vacuum Effect
ranks: Pull specimens within 1.15x capture radius at 0.5m/s
upgrades.effect: Pull strength cannot exceed 25% of a target's normal movement speed. Does not pull vehicles or bosses.

upgrades.name: Bulk Collection
upgrades.effect: Affects other occupied beams, not the capture that triggered it.

upgrades.name: Exit Interview
ranks: Soldier capture disables enemies within 4m for 0.5s
upgrades.effect: Shared 4-second cooldown; bosses immune.

upgrades.name: Additional Laser
upgrades.effect: Original laser stays at 100% damage. New mounts target independently.

upgrades.name: Piercing Light
upgrades.effect: Each secondary target receives 35% of original hit damage; hits require alignment.

upgrades.name: Chain Reaction
ranks: 20% chance to arc to 1 enemy at 35% damage
upgrades.effect: Only original laser hits can trigger an arc. Each arc searches within 5m; no repeat targets.

upgrades.name: Focused Fire
upgrades.effect: Five hits to maximum; one shared stack per target across all mounts. Expires after 2s without a laser hit.

upgrades.name: Orbital Security
upgrades.effect: Each drone deals 2 damage twice per second. Benefits from damage and fire-rate bonuses; cannot pierce or chain.

upgrades.name: Static Discharge
upgrades.effect: Benefits from Power Amplifier. Fire-rate bonuses do not shorten its cooldown.

upgrades.name: Personal Space
upgrades.effect: Adds capacity and immediately fills the added capacity.

upgrades.name: Bigger Bubble
upgrades.effect: Adds capacity and immediately fills the added capacity; no increase to hitbox.

upgrades.name: Reinforced Saucer
upgrades.effect: Immediately heals the amount of maximum hull added.

upgrades.name: Return to Sender
upgrades.effect: Requires shield energy before impact. Reflections prevent that hit and deal the projectile's original damage; cannot trigger weapon procs.

upgrades.name: Emergency Jump
upgrades.effect: Player activated; no damage or projectile-clearing effect.

upgrades.name: Tractor Stabiliser
upgrades.effect: Baseline movement penalty while capturing is 20%.

upgrades.name: Hostile Takeover
ranks: Vehicle kill grants +45% capture speed for 5s
upgrades.effect: Vehicle abductions do not count as kills for this proc.

upgrades.name: Power Diversion
ranks: +10% weapon damage per idle beam; cap +20%
upgrades.effect: Additive with Power Amplifier; never counts occupied vehicle slots as idle.

upgrades.name: Overtime
ranks: +8% firing rate per active beam; cap +24%
upgrades.effect: Additive with Rapid Discharge; benefits lasers and drones. Vehicle capture counts as one active beam for this bonus.

upgrades.name: Shield Siphon
upgrades.effect: Shared cap of 4 shield per second, including evolution restoration.

upgrades.name: Performance Bonus
ranks: Every 10 uninterrupted captures adds +2% reward; cap +10%
upgrades.effect: Hull damage resets streak; shield damage does not. Affects end-of-run currency/score only, not XP or upgrade frequency.

evolutions.name: The Great Vacuum
evolutions.effect: Replace four beams with one field holding six biological targets. +15% capture speed, but -10% movement while capturing. Six targets is a hard cap; no extra radius. Heavy Lifting uses two of those slots per vehicle.

evolutions.name: Office Shredder
evolutions.effect: Laser mounts sweep around the saucer. +25% total laser output against ordinary enemies; -10% against bosses because of reduced focused dwell time. Does not add extra mounts or fire-rate multipliers.

evolutions.name: Hostile Acquisition
evolutions.effect: Jeep capture threshold becomes 100% HP; tank threshold 55%. Vehicles yield 7 reward units instead of 5. Still needs two beam slots, tank capture minimum 2s, shared vehicle cooldown 8s; bosses immune.

evolutions.name: Mirrorball
evolutions.effect: Stores damage from reflected hits. Every 8s releases stored damage, capped at 40, divided among up to four nearby enemies. Does not add a second reflection roll or reflect boss contact damage.

evolutions.name: Employee Benefits
evolutions.effect: Captures grant drones +25% damage for 3s. Drones intercept one ordinary projectile per 6s across the whole squad, consuming 3 shield. At zero shield interception is disabled. Restoration shares Shield Siphon's 4/s cap.

evolutions.name: Storm Drain
evolutions.effect: Static pulse radius increases from 4m to 6m; non-boss enemies hit are slowed by 25% for 1s. Does not pull military units or add damage ticks; bosses receive at most 20% slow.
